name: Bosch Radiator Thermostat II (EU)

radios.note: Zigbee 3.0 in the 2.4 GHz band per the quick guide. The newer [+M] variant adds Thread; this record is the Zigbee-only version.

matter.note: The Zigbee-only version is not itself a Matter device. Bosch's product FAQ says it joins Matter systems through the Controller II as a Matter bridge, but we found no CSA listing for this model.

apple_home.note: Bosch's help page says Apple HomeKit works through the Smart Home Controller II and the Bosch Smart Home app.

google_home.note: Google Assistant works through the Smart Home Controller and the Bosch app.

alexa.note: Alexa works through the Smart Home Controller and the Bosch app.

smartthings.note: Bosch lists Samsung SmartThings only on the [+M] product page; nothing says how, or whether, the Zigbee-only model connects.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Bosch SHC integration lists a Thermostat Gen2 and a local push controller connection, but does not name the Radiator Thermostat II or the Controller II.

hubRequired.note: Bosch says not to run it long-term without a Smart Home Controller (no firmware updates), and its FAQ says only [+M] devices can skip the controller.

localControl.note: Bosch says the Controller II stores data locally and keeps automations running when the internet is down, but it makes no separate statement for this thermostat.

thermostatType.note: Fits onto the radiator valve and controls it.

systems.value: Radiators with M30 × 1.5 mm valve thread (adapters for some valves)
systems.note: M30 × 1.5 mm connection ring per the quick guide, which says some valves need a supplied adapter or one bought separately.

power.note: Typical battery life is under two years.

summary: The Bosch Radiator Thermostat II is a battery-powered Zigbee radiator head for M30 × 1.5 mm valves. It needs the Bosch Smart Home Controller II for long-term use, and Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa work through that controller and the Bosch app. Bosch also sells a [+M] version with Matter over Thread, which is a different model.
caveats: Bosch says the thermostat can run without a Smart Home Controller only briefly; there are no firmware updates without one.
The [+M] version with Matter over Thread is a different model; this record is the Zigbee-only one.
Bosch's help page says the Controller II does not support Matter or Thread, while a product FAQ says it acts as a Matter bridge; the two pages disagree.
